datasets.name: DPIRD
datasets.variables: Time series data - Evaporation, rainfall, solar radiation, air temperature, and others
datasets.method: Ad hoc handling of technical issues and missing values

datasets.name: SILO Point Data
datasets.variables: Continuous daily time series Evaporation, rainfall, solar radiation, air temperature, and others
datasets.method: Observational records or interpolated estimates for missing records

datasets.name: SILO Gridded Data
datasets.variables: Evaporation, rainfall, solar radiation, air temperature, and others
datasets.method: Gridded daily climate surfaces derived either by splining or kriging the observational data
datasets.access_conditions: Free, open download from the AWS Public Data Program (no email or registration)
datasets.temporal_coverage: Daily and monthly, from 1889 to the current year (mean sea level pressure from 1957, Class A pan evaporation from 1970)

datasets.name: ANUClimate 2.0
datasets.variables: Evaporation, rainfall, solar radiation, air temperature, and others
datasets.method: Derived from observational records, ANUSPLIN Version 4.6 spatial models
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project gh70, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: At least daily, from 1970 to present

datasets.name: AGCD v1.0.1
datasets.method: Consistent temporal and spatial analyses across Australia
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project zv2, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: Daily and monthly, from 1900 to 2022 inclusive (temperature from 1910, vapour pressure from 1971)

datasets.name: AGCD v2.0.2
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project zv2, or open download via NCI THREDDS

datasets.name: BOM Australian Water Outlook (AWRA-L)
datasets.variables: Precipitation, soil moisture, runoff, deep drainage and evapotranspiration
datasets.method: AWO is produced using a range of climate inputs, static grids and satellite observations as input into the Australian Water Resources Assessment Landscape model (AWRA-L)
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project iu04, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: daily gridded from 1911 until yesterday (historical), and water balance information, seasonal forecasts, and hydrological projections to 2100

datasets.name: CSIRO hourly near-surface air temperature grids
datasets.variables: Hourly air temperature and air temperature climatologies
datasets.method: Near-surface (1.5 m) air temperature grids for Australia. These data are spatially interpolated using quart-variate thin plate splines (full spline dependence on easting, northing, elevation, and time-varying coastal distance index).
datasets.temporal_coverage: hourly air temperature data from January 2015 and climatologies 1990-2019 (every 5th DOY)

datasets.name: BARRA-R2 and BARRA-RE2 (BARRA2)
datasets.variables: Temperature, moisture, wind and flux variables at sub-surface, surface, and pressure levels, and heights above surface. BARRA-R2 hourly includes max wind gust (wsgsmax), max wind speed (sfcWindmax) and surface soil moisture (mrsos)
datasets.method: BOM's higher resolution regional atmospheric reanalysis over Australia
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project ob53, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: sub-daily, daily and monthly, from 1979 to about 4 months behind present (BARRA-R2 hourly files to 2026-05 on 2026-10-02)

datasets.name: Queensland Future Climate 10 km CMIP6 projections
datasets.variables: Evaporation, rainfall, solar radiation, air temperature, and others
datasets.method: Gridded climate surfaces derived from regional projection models (QLD-DEC)
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project ig45, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: hourly (precipitation only), daily and monthly from several GCMs, historical (1960-2014) and SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5 to 2100 (scenarios vary by GCM), plus an ERA5-driven evaluation run
datasets.spatial_domain: Australasia (AUS-10i grid, about 89°E-182°E and 52°S-9°N), produced for Queensland

datasets.name: CHELSA V2.1
datasets.method: Combines mechanistic and statistical downscaling of GCMs

datasets.name: NASA POWER
datasets.resolution: ~111 km (1°) solar, ~55 x ~69 km (0.5° x 0.625°) meteorology
datasets.variables: Solar and meteorological data sets for support of renewable energy, building energy efficiency and agricultural needs
datasets.method: Derived from NASA research for renewable energy, building energy efficiency, and agricultural needs
datasets.access_conditions: Free and publicly accessible, including through an AWS bucket

datasets.name: WorldClim
datasets.variables: Temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, wind speed, water vapour pressure, bioclimatic variables
datasets.access_conditions: Free for ecological modelling and GIS

datasets.name: BARRA-C2
datasets.variables: Hourly near-surface wind, wind gust (wsgs) and hourly max gust (wsgsmax), surface soil moisture (mrsos), visibility, convective indices (CAPE, shear, helicity), temperature, precipitation and others
datasets.method: BOM convective-scale (kilometre-scale) downscaled reanalysis, part of BARRA2 (ACCESS model). Resolves convective gusts better than BARRA-R2
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project ob53, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: 20-minute, hourly, 3-hourly, daily and monthly, from 1979 to about 4 months behind present (hourly files to 2026-05 on 2026-10-02)

datasets.name: BARPA-R
datasets.variables: Sub-daily, daily and monthly temperature, moisture, wind (including parameterised gust) and flux variables
datasets.method: BOM ACCESS regional climate model downscaling of 7 CMIP6 GCMs and ERA5 for the Australian Climate Service (CORDEX-CMIP6 Australasia). Research product, not fully evaluated
datasets.access_conditions: NCI account and membership of project py18, or open download via NCI THREDDS
datasets.temporal_coverage: Historical, SSP1-2.6 and SSP3-7.0 (7 GCMs), SSP5-8.5 (ACCESS-CM2, EC-Earth3), to 2100. ERA5-driven evaluation run 1979-2022

datasets.name: ERA5
datasets.variables: Hourly atmospheric and surface variables, including 10 m wind, 10 m wind gust (instantaneous and max since previous post-processing), soil moisture, temperature and precipitation
datasets.method: ECMWF global reanalysis. Known to underestimate strong near-surface winds
datasets.access_conditions: Free with a Copernicus Climate Data Store account. NCI replica in project rt52
datasets.temporal_coverage: Hourly and monthly, from 1940 to about 5 days behind present

datasets.name: ERA5-Land
datasets.variables: Land surface variables: soil moisture (4 layers, top layer 0-7 cm), soil temperature, 10 m wind components (no gust), evaporation, runoff, temperature
datasets.method: ECMWF land surface model rerun at higher resolution, forced by ERA5
datasets.access_conditions: Free with a Copernicus Climate Data Store account. NCI replica in project zz93
datasets.temporal_coverage: Hourly and monthly, from 1950 to 2-3 months behind present

datasets.name: SMAP L4 Soil Moisture (SPL4SMGP)
datasets.variables: Surface (0-5 cm) and root-zone (0-100 cm) soil moisture
datasets.method: NASA SMAP L-band brightness temperatures assimilated into a land surface model. Gap-free, falls back to the model during instrument outages
datasets.access_conditions: Free with a NASA Earthdata login
